title: Isekai Craftsman: A Relaxing Tale of Chilling and Building from scratch
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Miyabi, a 'Crafter' whose in-game buildings in a VRMMO were popular as settings for marriage proposals, is sent to another world with his crafting skills intact. Free of his real-world job, he teams up with the adventurer Liz to gather materials, aiming to build his own house, start a family and live a slow, comfortable life.
life_message: A good life is a home you build with your own hands, a partner and a calm pace.

content.note: Bandits and an attempted murder noted (MU, 1 vote each); mostly slice of life.
Male-female travelling pair with romance (MU Romance genre; AniList Heterosexual).
Escape from an unfulfilling job implied (MangaDex description).
